verdict.rationale: Apple's own newsroom page explicitly states M4 Pro supports up to 64GB of unified memory (capacity ceiling) and 273GB/s of memory bandwidth, with memory type identified as 'fast unified memory,' giving a developer everything needed to size memory-bound workloads directly from vendor numbers. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on bandwidth benchmark corroboration and no explicit LPDDR5X memory-type naming (only 'unified memory').
